svg.title: Ancient explorer's map — Rohit Yadav's AI Engineering journey
svg.desc: A hand-drawn parchment map showing territories of AI Engineering, with charted and uncharted lands representing Rohit's data science journey from Mumbai
svg.text: A MAP OF AI ENGINEERING — CHARTED BY ROHIT OF MUMBAI
Cartographed in the year MMXXVI · Mumbai, Bharata · The journey continues northward
